metadata.note: Every tunable the engine uses lives here with a status. PROVISIONAL values are defensible starting points derived from the archive or from published football-modelling literature, NOT fitted numbers. The calibration harness (B-08) overwrites each one and flips its status to TUNED, recording the run that set it. The engine reads values regardless of status; statuses exist so nothing unfitted is ever mistaken for a fitted result.

status_legend.TUNED: set by a walk-forward calibration run; tuned_by names the run
status_legend.PROVISIONAL: starting value; must be re-fitted before xP is exposed in the UI
status_legend.STRUCTURAL: a modelling choice, not a fitted quantity (grid sizes, sim counts)

deoverround_method.note: power method with proportional fallback per 01 §3.0

fit_residual_tolerance.note: snapshots above this are flagged for review; real tolerance comes out of B-08

weights.note: equal weight on each market probability in the lambda fit; B-08 re-weights by how reliably each line predicts, and the totals line is expected to earn more weight than the draw

rho.note: Dixon-Coles low-score correction. Published EPL estimates sit near -0.03 to -0.13; MLE re-fit over the three-season archive is B-03/B-08 work.

grid_cap.note: goals per side; truncation mass measured and recorded by the projection run

goal_minute_model.note: order statistics of U(0,94) per goal; switch to the empirical archive minute distribution if B-03 shows material late skew

k_pos.note: shrinkage strength in 90s-played for npxG share; cross-validated in B-08

prior_season_decay.note: weight on last season's npxG when building the trailing window; fitted by cross-validation in B-08

finishing_K.note: shots at which the finishing multiplier reaches half weight

finishing_clamp.note: bound on the finishing-skill multiplier; the real clamp is a B-08 output

assist_share_of_goals.note: share of goals carrying a recorded assist; recompute from the archive in B-06

pen_rate_per_match.note: league penalties awarded per team-match; archive-derived per team in B-06

pen_conversion.note: league prior, shrunk toward the taker's own record by attempts

pen_duty_rank1.note: probability the rank-1 taker takes a given pen when on the pitch

promoted_sd_inflation.note: spread multiplier at full promoted blend; set from the promoted-cohort calibration slice scored separately in B-08

start_prior_k.note: Beta shrinkage strength on trailing start rate, in appearances

start_prior_by_price_band.note: price is the market's own minutes forecast and is the honest cold-start prior. Replaced by the isotonic-calibrated classifier in B-04.

p60_given_start.note: league mean; per-manager survival curves replace this in B-04

cameo_minutes.note: league mean minutes for a substitute appearance; replaced by per-manager sub-timing distributions in B-04

start_minutes.note: league mean minutes for a starter; replaced by per-manager sub-off survival curves in B-04

p_sub_on_before_30.note: probability a substitute enters early enough to reach 60 minutes; measured from the archive sub-on distribution in B-04

presser_signal_effect.note: multiplier on P(start), scaled by the signal's own confidence, clamped to [0,1]

chance_of_playing_floor.note: FPL chance_of_playing is used directly as a hard multiplier when present

wc_load_flag_effect.note: GW1-4 only; the real value is the B-01 fatigue-study output due 1 Aug. 1.0 = no effect until that study lands.

sims.note: N per fixture; overridable by SIMS env for local runs

shots_faced_per_lambda.note: opponent shots per unit of conceded lambda

sot_share_of_shots.note: shots on target as a share of shots faced, which sets keeper save volume; recomputed from the archive in B-07

in_box_share_of_saves.note: drives the 2026/27 in-box save BPS bonus

big_chance_share_of_saves.note: drives the new 2026/27 big-chance save BPS; validated against live bonus data through October, which is when the BPS edge expires

game_state_cbit_multiplier.note: defensive volume by game state, which is what makes DefCon fixture-dependent; estimated per game-state bucket from the archive in B-07

card_rate_scale.note: per-90 card rates come from the archive per player

haul_threshold.note: P(12+) is the campaign plan's haul definition

horizon_decay_per_gw.note: confidence decay applied to later gameweeks in the horizon sum

hit_threshold_points.note: gain over the horizon required to justify a -4. The real threshold is an A-11 / B-08 deliverable due 30 Jul.

captaincy_differential_tolerance.note: also an A-11 deliverable due 30 Jul

bench_quality_scale.note: maps mean bench score onto the ten-point readout; recalibrated once bench floors are scored on real autosub outcomes in B-10

interim.note: Parameters for the interim rating shown in the UI while xP is gated. This is deliberately a transparent blend of observed data, not a projection. It never writes to the projections table.

weights.note: blend behind the interim rating. Deleted, not tuned, the moment the xP gate opens: this exists only because showing an uncalibrated projection would be worse than showing observed data.

fixture_swing.note: maximum proportional adjustment from the fixture's goal environment
